theorems.name: Submission.tangentMeasure_projection_lower_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (E : Set (Rn N)) (a b δ : ℝ), 0 < a → 32 ^ n * b < a → (∀ x ∈ E, ∀ ρ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 δ, ENNReal.ofReal (a * ρ ^ n) ≤ μ (Metric.ball x ρ) ∧ μ ({z | ‖Q.starProjection (z - x)‖ ≤ ‖z - x‖ / 3} ∩ Metric.ball x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b * ρ ^ n)) → ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ y ∈ E, ‖y - x‖ < δ / 2 → ‖y - x‖ ≤ 4 * ‖Q.starProjection (y - x)‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
